title: Columbus Museum of Art

services.name: Docent Opportunites
services.desc: Columbus Museum of Art fosters creativity, critical thinking, and collaboration-skills students need to thrive. Our guided tours offer hands-on, inquiry-based learning experiences led by specially trained volunteer docents. Why Choose a School Tour or Field Trip at Columbus Museum of Art?Docents use thinking routines and strategic questioning to spark observation, imagination, multiple perspectives, and evidence-based reasoning. Research shows that students who participate in our inquiry-based field trips show lasting improvements in creative thinking, critical analysis, sensory engagement, and social connection. blurb: Through our outstanding collection, exhibitions, and programs, we seek to provide great experiences with great art for everyone. Founded in 1878, Columbus Museum of Art has long been a space for dialogue, connection, and transformative experiences with art.
